p=Path('internal/storage/fs/snapshot_test.go'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('\"io/fs\"\\n', '\"io/fs\"\\n\\t\"strings\"\\n',1); s+='''
func TestSnapshotRuleSegmentFormats(t *testing.T) {
 doc := "'`flags:
- key: flag1
  name: flag1
  type: VARIANT_FLAG_TYPE
  enabled: true
  rules:
  - segment: segment1
  - segment:
      keys: [segment1]
      operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR
  - segment:
      keys: [segment1, segment2]
      operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR
segments:
- key: segment1
  name: segment1
- key: segment2
  name: segment2
`
 ss, err := snapshotFromReaders(strings.NewReader(doc))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 rules, err := ss.ListRules(context.Background(), "default", "flag1")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Len(t, rules.Results, 3)
 for _, r := range rules.Results[:2] {
  assert.Equal(t, "segment1", r.SegmentKey)
  assert.Equal(t, flipt.SegmentOperator_OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR, r.SegmentOperator)
 }
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"segment1", "segment2"}, rules.Results[2].SegmentKeys)
 assert.Equal(t, flipt.SegmentOperator_AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR, rules.Results[2].SegmentOperator)
}
'"'''; p.write_text(s)
PY
